Careers

Join KELA & Shape the
Future of Cyber Threat Intelligence

Think like a hacker, fight like KELA

Our People

Join some of the brightest, most talented people in the cyber threat intelligence industry, and learn something new every day. We are a growing team that delivers the best intelligence through independent work and team effort, across research, engineering, sales and marketing.

Our Culture

KELA is a family. We believe you do your best work when you’re having fun! Come work with us and enjoy our daily happy hours, weekly drum or guitar lessons, coffee breaks on the sunny deck, spontaneous BBQ & wine lunches, and much more!

Our Offices

Our headquarters are located in the heart of Tel Aviv and featuring a stunning deck overlooking the city. The kitchen is fully stocked with unlimited cold, hot, and alcoholic drinks, ice cream, and plenty of delicious treats to keep you energized throughout the day. But that’s not it! You can also find us in Tokyo, London, New York, and San Francisco.
